def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    # Continue the diagonal progression of the 1s, changing new terms to 2.
    ones.sort()
    dr = ones[-1][0] - ones[-2][0]
    dc = ones[-1][1] - ones[-2][1]
    r,c = ones[-1]
    while r+dr < n and c+dc < m:
        r += dr; c += dc
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
